questions.stem: A 65-year-old patient presents with constipation, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, confusion, and bone pain. Laboratory tests reveal elevated calcium levels. Considering the role of the calcium-sensing receptor (CaSR) in calcium homeostasis, which of the following is regulated by CaSR?
